title: Global EPC Company and Project Brief
summary: Initial sample brief used to activate the automated Daily Brief page. Future entries will be generated by the scheduled EPC intelligence task.

zh.summary: 用于启用每日简报页面的初始样例。后续记录将由定时 EPC 情报任务自动生成。

items.headline: Daily publishing pipeline activated
items.progress: The site now reads daily brief content from JSON data files.
items.impact: The scheduled EPC brief can publish directly to GitHub Pages without editing HTML.

zh.headline: 每日发布流水线已启用
zh.progress: 网站现在会从 JSON 数据文件读取每日简报内容。
zh.impact: 定时 EPC 简报可以直接发布到 GitHub Pages，无需手动编辑 HTML。

items.headline: Latest project intelligence will appear here
items.progress: The next scheduled run will replace this sample with a live EPC project brief.
items.impact: Readers can track new awards, FID, construction starts, delays, and steel package signals in one page.

zh.headline: 最新项目情报将显示在这里
zh.progress: 下一次定时任务会用实时 EPC 项目简报替换这个样例。

items.headline: Direct publishing mode enabled
items.progress: New briefs will be committed to the repository and published by GitHub Pages.
items.impact: The website becomes a living archive instead of a static daily brief placeholder.

zh.headline: 直接发布模式已启用
zh.progress: 新的简报会提交到仓库，并由 GitHub Pages 发布。
zh.impact: 网站将成为持续更新的历史归档，而不是静态占位页面。
